Alibaba launches advanced AI model, Qwen3.8-Max

Alibaba has launched its most capable artificial intelligence model to date, named Qwen3.8-Max. The company claims this new model is not far behind competitors like Moonshot's Kimi K3 in terms of size and capability. This development marks a significant step in Alibaba's AI development efforts.
